title: Blueprint
line: Laid out with a compass, then set running.
idea: Draws on: chalk-white line on diazo blue over a drafting grid. The construction cross, each orbit swung like a compass, the degree ring, the Sun and planets with hatched night sides, a dimension, a north arrow and a title block.
loop: Every planet runs a whole number of orbits, twelve for Mercury down to one for Neptune, trailing a pencil-yellow arc of its path.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in blueprint style: white compass-drawn orbit circles on a blue drafting grid around a yellow-rayed sun, eight planets with hatched night sides, Saturn ringed and the Earth with its moon, each trailing a yellow arc as it circles.

title: Woodblock
line: Every orbit cut by hand, every planet a block of colour.
idea: Starts whole: an ukiyo-e print on washi. A Prussian-blue block wiped into a bokashi from the pale centre to the deep corners with stars carved out of it, flat colour blocks for the Sun and planets, and the key block printed a hair out of register, with a cartouche, a seal and a kento mark.
loop: The planets run their orbits, each carrying an indigo overprint on the half turned from the Sun.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in Japanese woodblock-print style: black carved orbit lines on cream paper fading to deep blue at the corners, a vermilion sun in an ochre halo, flat-coloured planets with indigo shadows, and a title cartouche with a red seal in the corner.

title: Sumi Ink
theme: A few strokes of the brush
idea: Draws on: soot ink on bone rice paper. The Sun first, a loaded black enso round a vermilion wash, then each orbit as its own open enso in paler and paler ink, the planets dabbed on in two touches, ink flicked into the belt, a column of writing and the seal.
loop: The dabs slide round their brushed rings, each with its black touch always on the side away from the Sun.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in sumi ink: open brush-stroke circles in black and grey ink around a red sun, with planets as ink dabs half grey and half black, a spatter of ink dots between them, and a column of brushed characters with a red seal at the right.

title: Etching
line: Tone is only ever the density of lines.
idea: Starts whole: a two-plate intaglio print inside its platemark. The cold plate hatches the sky, deepening outward in three bites and burnished clean along each orbit; the warm plate engraves the Sun in rings and rays and models every planet with contour lines and cross-hatching.
loop: The planets turn their hatched night sides away from the Sun as they go; the sky's lines never move.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in etching style: a circular engraved plan of the solar system in fine cross-hatched lines on cream paper, the sun a ringed disc in a burst of rays, planets shaded with hatching, inside a ruled square border with engraved corner fans and lettering.

title: Riso
line: Blue, pink and yellow, and everything else is an overprint.
idea: Starts whole: a risograph poster in medium blue, fluorescent pink and yellow on warm stock. Each ink is its own plate with its own halftone angle, misregistration and uneven coverage; the Sun's orange, the Earth's green and Neptune's violet are overprints.
loop: The planets carry their plates round, their night halves screened in blue, a pink halftone wake fading out behind each.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in risograph poster style: a blue halftone sky with pale orbit rings, a large orange and pink sun at the centre, colourful halftone planets with pink wakes behind them, printed slightly out of register inside a paper margin.

title: Stipple
line: Every orbit, every shadow, one dot at a time.
idea: Starts whole: lamp-black and a sunset rose on grey laid paper. Orbits are chains of dots, the sky darkens to the corners by density alone, the Sun is a rose sphere darkening at its limb, and each planet is a stippled sphere.
loop: Each planet carries its own dots; only which are inked changes as the light moves across it. A short wake of rose dots follows each.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in stipple: dotted orbit rings on pale grey paper around a sun made of rose dots, planets drawn as dotted spheres with dark sides facing away from the sun, and trails of rose dots behind them.

title: Pastel on Black
line: On black paper, only what is lit gets drawn.
idea: Starts whole: soft pastel on dark toothy paper. The Sun is hundreds of radiating strokes from cream to orange, each orbit a soft chalk line, each planet lit in its own colour on its sunward side and left bare black on the other, all of it broken by the tooth and bloomed.
loop: The planets drag smudges of their colour behind them as they circle, and the stars twinkle a whole number of times per loop.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in pastel on black paper: a glowing orange and yellow sun of chalk strokes at the centre of soft grey orbit rings, colourful planets lit on the sunward side with smudged colour trails behind them, among twinkling stars.

title: Cut Paper
line: Eight sheets of blue, and a sun cut from three.
idea: Starts whole: the orbits are the scissor-cut rims of eight stacked sheets of blue, lightening towards the Sun, each casting a soft shadow on the one below; the Sun is three layers of paper; the planets are paper discs with pasted bands, rings and land.
loop: The planets ride round the rims of their sheets with their shadows under them; the Sun's paper star turns once.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in layered cut paper: concentric hand-cut blue paper discs stacked with soft shadows, an orange paper star and yellow disc for the sun, and small paper planets including a striped Jupiter and a ringed Saturn riding the edges, on a navy background with paper-punch stars.

title: Bauhaus
line: Circles, halves and squares in three colours.
idea: Starts whole: a screen print on bone paper in black, red, yellow and blue. A black band, a red square and a blue quarter-disc frame the plan of hard black circles; the Sun is a red disc in a yellow one; each planet is a circle split exactly in two.
loop: Every planet's black half keeps turning from the Sun as it goes; the belt is a ring of small black squares, each squared to its orbit.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in Bauhaus style: thin black orbit circles on cream paper around a red and yellow sun, planets as flat circles half coloured and half black, a ring of small black squares, with a black band, a red square and a blue quarter circle framing the composition.

title: Art Deco
line: Gold on lacquer, opening like a fan.
idea: Draws on: gold line on black lacquer. The Sun's spikes and a ring of fine rays burst out, the double-ruled orbits sweep on from the inside out, the stepped frame and its corner fans draw in, and the planets take their places over peacock-teal wedges.
loop: The planets turn their engraved gold faces to the Sun, stars flash in turn, and a sheen of light crosses all the gold once.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on.
alt: Sketch in art deco style: a gold spiked sunburst at the centre of double gold orbit lines on black, with teal wedges radiating behind, gold-ringed planets engraved with fine lines, gold diamonds on the outer orbits and a stepped gold frame with fan-shaped corners.
